name: creator_diagnostic
description: Measure how a creator edits from up to 30 of their posts (links or local video files): cut rate, shot lengths, speech pace, opening line, music and beat-cutting, aspect, length and palette. Medians over the most-viewed `top` posts plus per-video values, with a shot sheet and an opening frame per video. One item gives a one-video breakdown. Videos it downloads, and videos in `inbox`, are deleted once measured.

output.description: {out, diagnostic, measured, failed}. diagnostic.json (schema 1) and stills/ are in out.

params.name: items
params.description: JSON array of up to 30 posts, newest first: [{"url": "..."} or {"path": "..."}, plus optional "views", "likes", "posted_at" (YYYY-MM-DD), "caption"]

params.name: out
params.description: Folder for diagnostic.json and stills/ (default: a new temp folder)

params.name: inbox
params.description: Folder holding videos saved for this run; each is deleted once measured

params.name: top
params.description: How many posts to measure: the most-viewed, else the newest
